dataset: option40 - Greeks signal test (Gamma/Vega/Theta/Delta levels + ratios)
hypothesis: Greeks (gamma/vega/theta/delta) capture different info from IV skew. These fields have VERY LOW user counts (4-26 vs 20-73 for IV). Might have lower prod_corr.

analysis.conclusion: Greeks levels (gamma/vega/theta/delta) are DEAD signals after SLOW_AND_FAST neutralization. All 8 alphas have sh<0.85, far below 1.58 threshold. Best: Gamma ratio (sh0.85) captures gamma term structure slope but still too weak.
analysis.key_insight: Like IV mean, Greek levels describe option price sensitivities determined by moneyness/expiry/volatility - all captured by risk model and neutralized away. Only IV skew (call-put differential) carries unique predictive info NOT in risk models.
analysis.implication: Option40 Greeks are exhausted. Only IV skew works, but prod_corr>0.7 at all tenors. Need to try: (1) short-term IV skew (10d/20d), (2) IV skew momentum (ts_delta), (3) Put-Call Greek differentials, (4) IV skew with different neutralization.
